collection.description: A villager makes a harmlessly intended joke that embarrasses a friend.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) makes a harmlessly intended joke that embarrasses (friend).

choices.label: Find a Gentler Way to Share Humor

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (friend) accepts the apology and jokes about something else.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (friend) needs time before feeling comfortable again.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (villager) learns that the topic was personally sensitive.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (friend) explains they simply disliked being the center of attention.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The pause makes (villager) anxious, but they respect it.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The two discover a shared taste for silly stories.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (friend) laughs at the new joke but asks for fewer surprises.
